रध्,
 
-रन्ध् 4 P. (रध्यति, रद्ध; caus. रन्धयति; desid. रिरधिषति or रिरत्सति) 
__1 To hurt, injure, torment, kill, destroy; अक्षं रधितुमारेभे [[

.]] 
__2 To subdue. 
__3 To become subject to (any one). 
__4 Ved. To die. 
__5 Ved. To be completed. -Caus. (रन्धयति) 
__1 To hurt, injure; भरतं शोकसंतप्तं भूयः शोकैररन्धयत् [[

.]] 
__2 To oppress, torment. 
__3 To dress, cook or prepare (as food).

P. (राध्नोति, राद्ध; desid. रिरात्सति, but रित्सति to ‘wish to kill’) 
__1 To propitiate, conciliate, please. 
__2 To accomplish, effect, complete, perform, achieve. 
__3 To prepare, make ready. 
__4 To fall to the lot of any one (also 4 P.). 
__5 To injure, destroy, kill, exterminate; वानरा भूधरान् रेधुः [[

P. (राध्यति, राद्ध) 
__1 To be favourable or merciful. 
__2 To be accomplished or finished. 
__3 To propitiate, look to the welfare of (any one, with dat.); कृष्णाय राध्यति गर्गः [[Sk.]] (i. e. पृष्टो गर्गः शुभाशुभं पर्यालोचयति). 
__4 To be successful, to succeed, prosper. 
__5 To be ready. 
__6 To kill, destroy. -Caus. (राधयति-ते) 
__1 To propitiate. 
__2 To accomplish, complete. 
__3 To make ready.

a. Ved. 
__1 Rich, liberal. 
__2 Happy. 
__3 Worshipping. 
__4 Injuring.

The month called Vaiśākha. 
-धः, -धम् 
__1 Favour, kindness. 
__2 Prosperity. 
-धी The day of full moon in the month of Vaiśākha. 
-Comp. 
-रङ्कः 
__1 a plough. 
__2 thin rain. 
__3 hail.

[राध्-ल्युट्] 
__1 Propitiating, conciliating. 
__2 Pleasure, satisfaction. 
__3 Accomplishing, effecting, completion. 
__4 Acquisition, going. 
__5 The means of accomplishing anything. 
-ना Speech. 
-नी Worship.

n. Ved. 
__1 Food. 
__2 Kindness, favour. 
__3 A gift, present. 
__4 Liberality. 
__5 Wealth, riches. 
__6 Accomplishment of one's wishes, success; तस्मा अप्यनुभावेन स्वेनैवावाप्तराधसे [[

.]] 
__9 Device, proper application; बुद्धपा वा किं निपुणया बलेनेन्द्रियराधसा [[

.]] 
__10 Maintaining, keeping (पालनम्); आत्मारामोऽपि यस्त्वस्य लोककल्पस्य राधसे [[

.]] 
__10 The sensual pleasure; कृष्णे कमलपत्राक्षे संन्यस्ताखिलराधसः [[

__1 Prosperity, success. 
__2 N. of a celebrated Gopī or cowherdess loved by Kṛṣṇa (whose amours have been immortalized by Jayadeva in his Gītagovinda); तदिमं राधे गृहं प्रापय [[

.]] 
__3 N. of the wife of Adhiratha and foster-mother of Karṇa. 
__4 The lunar mansion called विशाखा. 
__5 Lightning. 
__6 An attitude in shooting. 
__7 Emblic Myrobalan. 
__8 The full-moon day in the month of Vaiśākha. 
__9 Devotedness. 
__10 N. of a plant (Clytoria Ternatea; Mar. विष्णुक्रान्ता). 
-Comp. 
-कान्तः, -पतिः, -रमणः N. of Kṛṣṇa. 
-भेदिन्, -वेधिन् m. N. of Arjuna. 
-सुतः N. of Karṇa.
An epithet of Karṇa; पुत्रस्य मे सुहृत् प्रेयान् राधेयः सोऽप्ययं हतः [[
